journal: Journal of Chemical and Engineering Data 29, 45-52
title: Density, viscosity, and electrolytic conductivity of concentrated aqueous electrolyte solutions at several temperatures. Alkaline-earth chlorides, LaCl3, Na2SO4, NaNO3, NaBr, KNO3, KBr, and Cd(NO3)2
experimental_method: Density with Weld-type 25 cm3 densitometers calibrated on pure water, viscosity with two Ubbelohde capillary viscometers (kinetic-energy corrected, relative to water and secondary standard solutions), conductivity with a four-electrode cell, in a bath controlled to +-0.001 C; molal-basis solutions from 0.05 mol/kg to near saturation, 15-55 C.
uncertainties_stated: density duplicates agree to < 0.01 kg m-3; flow times reproducible within 0.03 s; bath +-0.01 C at each temperature; no overall uncertainty stated
